products.name: AFTER DARK
products.tagline: You weren't meant to play safe.
products.description: A bold, intoxicating blend that lingers long after you've left the room. Built for the ones who own the night. AFTER DARK opens with a sharp crack of black pepper and a whisper of saffron, settling into a deep heart of oud and amber. The dry-down is warm, smoky sandalwood laced with dark vanilla — the kind of scent that makes people lean in closer.

reviews.name: Arjun
reviews.comment: Finally found a perfume that actually feels like me. Dark, addictive and gets noticed every time.

reviews.name: Meera
reviews.comment: Obsessed. The sillage is insane — people ask me what I'm wearing every single time.

reviews.name: Dev
reviews.comment: This is not a fragrance, it's an entrance. Lasts 10+ hours easily.

products.name: SINNER
products.description: Dark rose meets raw vetiver in a scent that doesn't ask permission — it takes attention. SINNER is designed for the unapologetically bold. The opening is a clash of dark Turkish rose and sharp green vetiver, softened by a heart of velvety musk. As it dries, tonka bean and black orchid emerge — addictive, warm, and impossible to forget.

reviews.name: Rahul
reviews.comment: Bought it for myself. My girlfriend stole it.

reviews.name: Priya
reviews.comment: The rose note is dark, not sweet. Exactly what I was looking for.

products.name: RED FLAG
products.tagline: They warned you. You didn't listen.
products.description: Saffron and leather collide with earthy patchouli. Bold, dangerous, and completely irresistible. RED FLAG is not subtle — and it's not trying to be. It opens with a golden burst of saffron and warm cardamom, evolving into a heart of supple leather and deep patchouli. The base is smoky birch and labdanum, leaving a trail that's as magnetic as it is mysterious.

reviews.name: Isha
reviews.comment: Not another boring perfume brand. The whole vibe is different. I haven't gone back.

reviews.name: Vikram
reviews.comment: The leather note is chef's kiss. Compliment magnet at every party.

products.name: NO APOLOGIES
products.description: Bergamot cuts through smoky cedarwood in a scent that's refined yet rebellious. For the ones who never explain themselves. NO APOLOGIES opens bright with Italian bergamot and a hint of pink pepper, then deepens into a woody heart of cedarwood and a subtle smoke accord. The base is clean white musk and vetiver — crisp, confident, and effortlessly cool.

reviews.name: Karan
reviews.comment: Clean but edgy. Perfect for everyday without being forgettable.

reviews.name: Ananya
reviews.comment: My go-to for office and dates. Versatile king.

products.name: HOLY SMOKE
products.description: Incense and tobacco leaf wrapped in warm amber. A ritual for the irreverent. HOLY SMOKE is a fragrance that feels like walking into a candlelit room you weren't invited to. The opening is smoky frankincense and aromatic tobacco leaf, settling into a rich amber heart with hints of labdanum. The dry-down is warm cashmeran and sandalwood — meditative, sensual, and deeply personal.

products.name: MIDNIGHT CONFESSION
products.tagline: What happens after midnight stays on your skin.
products.description: Black cherry and suede melt into a base of dark musk. Intimate, addictive, and made for close encounters. MIDNIGHT CONFESSION is the scent equivalent of a whispered secret. It opens with the sweetness of black cherry tempered by cool suede, blooming into a heart of jasmine absolute and iris. The base is dark musk and benzoin — warm, resinous, and impossibly close.
